Document workflow with OCR and AI

From invoice and bank transaction to proposed description and discrepancy checks. An example of a system for a corporate group, with human verification.

Document and payment must meet

An invoice arrives as a file, its data enters the cost workflow, and payment confirmation is found in banking data. The system combines these sources into a case that can be verified and settled.

We designed a workflow where automated matching and model processing have distinct roles. Rules handle straightforward cases; AI helps extract content and prepare proposals where identifiers alone are not sufficient.

How AI works on an invoice

  1. The document is sent for extraction. The model analyzes the PDF or photo and proposes invoice fields in an established structure.
  2. A missing value remains missing. An unreadable or absent field should return empty rather than being filled with guesswork.
  3. The system compares data. It contrasts the extracted amount with independent document or payment data and highlights discrepancies.
  4. The responsible person checks the result. The extracted data remains a proposal for review. The OCR result alone does not silently overwrite the document amount.

What happens to an unrecognized payment

After rule-based transaction matching, some items still require clarification. AI analyses the payment reference and counterparty description, suggests the nature of the transaction, provides justification, and flags uncertainty.

The model does not modify monetary amounts. Its output helps the workflow operator decide where to allocate an item or what needs verification.

Result visible in the process

The outcome is a document with extracted fields, a proposed description, and details about any discrepancies. The responsible person can go to the source and evaluate the suggestion.

Model vendor selection, permitted data, and access policies are part of the implementation. We conduct quality control on representative documents, taking into account extraction errors and ambiguous cases.

What we can transfer to your company

A similar workflow can be tailored to handle invoices, purchasing documents, or other materials requiring extraction and verification. First, we define data sources, comparison rules, and the approving person.

The project is anonymous; we do not publish invoices, counterparties, balances, or financial results. See AI in processes and data integrations.
